notes: family: running-track-race (ruby race). Ways of earning rubies are not itemised. Big Box adds Mocha & Baksheesh and Letters & Seals (end condition and tiebreak taken as unchanged from base per secondary source) and a 5x5 bazaar option. Verified against a rules summary only; official rulebook PDF could not be downloaded, so exact wording for expansions (and whether expansions alter the ruby target) is unconfirmed.
